why: Slow-sipping, aromatic and compatible with many medium/full cigar profiles.
Roasted profile works with tobacco and keeps the scenario non-alcoholic.
Tannin and warmth suit tobacco without alcohol.
Neutral palate cleanser; useful when the cigar itself should remain dominant.
Mint, lime and ice fit hot-weather refreshment.
Aromatic but calm and easy to sip slowly.
Casual, food-friendly and easy to serve over a long session.
Useful celebratory option when alcohol preferences or restrictions are unknown.
